name: pumperdotfun
description: Pump.fun-style bonding-curve launchpad on Base with Uniswap V2 migration

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix contracts install && npm --prefix indexer install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix subgraph install
scripts.deploy:base: npm --prefix contracts run deploy:base && npm run sync
scripts.deploy:baseSepolia: npm --prefix contracts run deploy:baseSepolia && npm run sync:baseSepolia
scripts.build:all: npm run build:contracts && npm --prefix indexer run build && npm --prefix subgraph run build && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix contracts test && npm --prefix indexer run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run check:deps && npm --prefix subgraph run build
